name: 15c rope relative angle
title: Rotating by position keeps the score tied to the offset
subtitle: Section 8 toy: raw query (1, 2), raw key (3, 2), each position adds 45 degrees of rotation

steps.caption: Before any rotation the query (1, 2) and key (3, 2) score 3 + 4 = 7. Both sit at position 0, 30 degrees apart.
Query at position 2 turns 90 degrees to (-2, 1). Key at position 1 turns 45 degrees to (0.71, 3.54). They are now 75 degrees apart and the score is 2.121.
Shift both two positions later. The arrows land somewhere new, but they are still 75 degrees apart, so the score is still 2.121.
Again at positions 6 and 5. The offset is 1 every time, and the score never moves from 2.121.
Now move only the key, to position 4. The offset becomes 2, the arrows open to 120 degrees, and the score drops to -4.
Put both at position 6. The offset is 0, the rotations cancel, and the score is the raw 7 again.
Every row with offset 1 scores 2.121, offset 2 scores -4 and offset 0 scores 7. The score depends on how far apart the tokens are, not on where they sit.
